paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 values for DPR with different expansion methods as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10," also has a linear scale with values ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines: a black line representing DPR w/o query, a red line representing DPR w/ corpus expansion with circle markers and a solid line style, showing an increase from approximately 35.2 to 35.8 as the number of queries increases from 1 to 10; a green line representing DPR w/ document expansion with triangle markers and a solid line style, remaining relatively steady around 34.9; and a blue line representing DPR w/ asymmetric expansion with star markers and a solid line style, fluctuating and ending at approximately 34.2.
